text: The third season of Love Is Blind premiered on Netflix on October 19, 2022, and ended on November 9, 2022, with a reunion episode released on that same date. A three-part companion special titled After the Altar was released on February 10, 2023. This season featured singles from Dallas, Texas, all of whom lived in Dallas during filming. In 2023, Bartise Bowden appeared on the first season of Perfect Match, finishing as a finalist. According to Netflix and production company Kinetic Content, there were no unaired engagements in Season 3; all couples who got engaged in the pods were included in the show.
